name: Twinkle Little Star
source:
Main character goes to the southern island and meets mermaids there. Where will it lead to?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
